disclaimer:
This harness produces a directional signal, not a publishable effect size. The
shipped goal set is 12 items, not the ≥100 that Nooplex §8.5 asks for, because
each item costs a full live crew run. Cohen's d and its confidence interval are
reported so the direction and rough magnitude of the Σ effect are visible; the
harness never claims statistical significance and never prints the word
"significant". §8.5 compliance is not claimed.
notes: Judge and system under test share a model family. A human-evaluation panel (Nooplex 8.4) is out of scope for this AD. Blinding, a fixed temperature and per-row judge model/tier recording are the affordable mitigations.

PROBOS_EMBEDDINGS=local makes the embedding function lexical, not semantic, so AD-1138's index is measurably weaker here than it would be with real embeddings. That biases the run against the treatment arm: a positive result under local embeddings is a floor, not a ceiling.
STRUCTURAL MODE. Scores come from a deterministic scripted client and mean nothing about the effect of shared knowledge flow. This artifact proves the harness, not a result.
synthesis=deterministic_transcript_v1: accepted child outputs are concatenated in a stable order rather than folded by an LLM, so the coordination seams survive to the judge.
measured crew LLM calls per goal (B-2), summed over both arms and all 1 trial(s), judge calls excluded: {"s01": 4, "s02": 4}
judge LLM calls: 4 (one per scored artifact).
blind presentation order is seeded at 1143 and recorded per goal so the unblinding is auditable.
